g.text: Total stress tensor components and pressure
Exact: blue line. FGMRES: red dots. All stresses and pressure are in MPa.
σxx = σ′xx − P; σyy = σ′yy − P; σzz = σ′zz − P
σxy = σ′xy; σxz = σ′xz; σyz = σ′yz
Symmetry gives six independent stress components.
Profile at y/Ly = 0.37 and z/Lz = 0.43. Component signs and pressure gauge are unchanged.
